what: An illustrative high-pressure separator state, taken from CHEPTA's decision file docs/decisions/2026-11-06-02-mhv1.md (copied unchanged to upstream/2026-11-06-02-mhv1.md). It is not a state of the CO2-to-methanol paper (medrano-garcia-2025): that paper's supplement is not yet audited, and no paper condition is used here.
locator: CHEPTA v0.6.0, docs/decisions/2026-11-06-02-mhv1.md, section "The maintainer's answers on #214 (2026-11-07)", item 3, "The separator flash": (CO2, H2, CO, methanol, water = 0.2/0.5/0.05/0.15/0.1, 313 K, 5 MPa); the same state in CHEPTA's test/eos-mhv1.test.js
basis_note: Lab's choice: the decision file gives mole fractions only. The flash results compared (liquid fraction, liquid mole fractions) do not depend on the total flow.
